svg.title: D03 INGENUITY DESCENT & BUBBLE LAB engineering architecture
svg.desc: D03a and D03b retain separate physics and acceptance paths. Only a reviewed aerodynamic uncertainty envelope connects them; stationary bubble spectra do not directly establish autorotating-probe performance.
